notes: Absolute atmosphere gates for BL-0148 step 2 (G12). Luminance is 0-255 (0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B) in the sky band of a 1536x1024 Town render (map pixels = image pixels). Hue: night means mean B>R+4; warm means mean R>B+4. Wind displacement is the mean absolute luma difference in flag_roi between two frames 0.40s apart when scheduled wind_kmh>0. Day 2 of the client seeded schedule is used: 07:30 cloudy 12 km/h, 12:30 windy 28, 18:30 clear 8, 22:00 windy 28. Attempt-2 additions (art-derived, not from TOWN_WINDOWS/LAMPS): (a) lit-window pixels must lie in the glass mask derived from town.png, with a tiny spill tolerance; (b) each substantial glow centroid must sit within N px of an art-derived lamp sprite, and the café-front ROI glow centroid must also sit on a lamp (no orphan halo on the terrace); (c) every art-derived lamp has a circular halo after dark; (d) 18:30 town body (below the sky band) has an absolute warmth (R-B) and saturation floor. Attempt-3 additions: (b) glow-on-lamp also runs on the whole building band, treating wall-coloured lit pixels outside a real window pane as a glow (so a stray facade patch is flagged even if the glass mask leaked); (e) every art-derived lamp is off in daylight (07:30 and 12:30) — the lamp-head sprite itself must not read as a lit bulb.
